---
name: Specification Ambiguity
about: Report an ambiguity or underspecified behavior in spec/SPEC.md or spec/MATCHING.md
title: "[SPEC]: "
labels: ["spec", "standard"]
assignees: ""
---

**Specification Section**
Link to the relevant section in `spec/SPEC.md`, `spec/MATCHING.md`, or `spec/schemas/`.

**The Ambiguity**
Describe where the normative text permits multiple contradictory interpretations by an independent implementer.

**Proposed Clarification**
Suggest exact normative prose or JSON schema updates to resolve the ambiguity deterministically.

**Impact on Independent SDKs (Rust, Go, TypeScript)**
Explain how different language implementations would be affected without this clarification.
